parameters.name: PermissionNames
parameters.description: The names of the permissions to apply. If this parameter is omitted, the system automatically applies the default permission for the resource type. For more information, see [Permission library](~~465474~~).

parameters.name: ResourceArns
parameters.description:
The ARNs of the shared resources.

You can specify up to five resources in a single request.

parameters.name: ResourceShareId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource share.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: The resources to associate with the resource share.

sub_parameters.name: ResourceId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the shared resource.

> `Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` must be specified together.

sub_parameters.name: ResourceType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the shared resource.

You can specify up to five resources in a single request.

For a list of supported resource types, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing](~~450526~~).

> `Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` must be specified together.

parameters.name: TargetProperties
parameters.description:
The properties of the principals.

> This parameter applies only when a principal is an Alibaba Cloud service.

parameters.name: Targets
parameters.description: The principals to associate with the resource share.
